outcome: The worker and verifier harness stops taxing honest work: scratch state and build caches persist across one invocation's commands and die with it, a failing command returns its output and exit code instead of vanishing, exact bytes travel to sworn_submit by file reference, verification work-context spells out the candidate's ancestry, and read-only workspaces expose read-only git.

exclude: state shared between invocations or roles
write access to any git surface from any worker
relaxing the -parallel=1 end-to-end mandate (blocked on the retry-semantics slice)

acceptance.text: One host scratch directory per invocation is bound read-write at /home/sworn and /tmp for every command of that invocation and destroyed at session close; state written there persists between a worker's commands and never reaches a fresh invocation.
A command completing with non-zero exit returns bounded combined output and its exit code as a failed tool result; only starts, kills and overflows remain contract errors.

sworn_submit plan/checks accept {byte_count, digest, path} naming a workspace, projected-input or scratch file; the engine reads the bytes itself, the declared digest still binds them, and a symlink escaping the scratch surface is refused.

End-to-end crash and lease hooks are linked once behind testHooksFromEnv and travel per-process as SWORN_TEST_* environment; the short owner lease reaches only tests that wait out claim expiry, and every other test keeps the production lease.
Verification work-context carries candidate.base and candidate.chain naming the base, candidate and receipt ancestry explicitly, so a verifier proves custody without base-chain archaeology.
A read-only workspace exposes functional read-only git (common dir and worktree git dir read-only bound); read-write workers keep .git masked, and no role gains a write path to any git surface.

constraints: The reference diff projected as input is the commitment: land exactly those changes, adapted only where the base moved.
The isolation boundary is between invocations and roles, never between consecutive commands of one worker; nothing may weaken the former to serve the latter.
Production binaries carry no runtime crash knob: the hook gate remains reachable only through ldflags.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository; the candidate diff carries only product changes.
